description: Tripo v1 only. Visual anatomical centres selected on calibrated orthographic renders. No bone fitting or shape correction. x is positive half-span; z is source height above the sole. Crown, crotch and sole are sampled by prepare.py.

eye.method: mean pupil line in textured front view

shoulder.method: estimated arm socket centres under puff sleeves; excludes outer sleeve padding

elbow.method: estimated joint centres under sleeves; lateral centre checked against front ray-sampled silhouette interval midpoint at this estimated height (0.0005 raw-metre sampling)

wrist.method: hand/forearm transition under bracelets; lateral centre checked against front ray-sampled silhouette interval midpoint at this estimated height (0.0005 raw-metre sampling)

hip.method: estimated hip joint centres from exposed hidden trouser mesh, not belt height

knee.method: estimated patella centres from hidden trouser mesh front and side; lateral centre checked against front ray-sampled silhouette interval midpoint at this estimated height (0.0005 raw-metre sampling)

ankle.method: estimated joint centres inside boots, not boot cuff; lateral centre checked against front ray-sampled silhouette interval midpoint at this estimated height (0.0005 raw-metre sampling)

eye.method: mean pupil line in textured front view

shoulder.method: estimated arm socket centres below exposed shoulder contour

elbow.method: estimated joint centres from arm contour; lateral centre checked against front ray-sampled silhouette interval midpoint at this estimated height (0.0005 raw-metre sampling)

wrist.method: hand/forearm transition under bracelets; lateral centre checked against front ray-sampled silhouette interval midpoint at this estimated height (0.0005 raw-metre sampling)

hip.method: estimated hip joint centres from exposed shorts/leg mesh, not belt height

knee.method: estimated patella centres from exposed legs front and side; lateral centre checked against front ray-sampled silhouette interval midpoint at this estimated height (0.0005 raw-metre sampling)

ankle.method: estimated joint centres inside platform boots, not boot cuff; lateral centre checked against front ray-sampled silhouette interval midpoint at this estimated height (0.0005 raw-metre sampling)
